strategy.title: No executable plan: one $3,200 buyer against a $9,000 target
strategy.why: The only evidenced sale is Harlan's $3,200 PO, which settles by day 32. The target needs at least two more $3,200 sales delivered by about day 13 (net 30), but the record establishes no population of other buyers: the payer and the reachable channel are Harlan alone, and nobody has counted how many shops buy this or how often. One organisation is not a market, so the remaining $5,800 rests on buyers nobody has shown exist.

reviews.reasons: NO_PLAN is right. The only opening cop_dd6828fceb864333a73c has one real purchase (Harlan's PO HPM-4471, $3,200, written acceptance), but payer and channel are Harlan alone: one organisation is not a population, and Brain's MARKET_VOLUME and CONVERSION links are both false on the card. Recomputed: ceil(9,000/3,200) = 3 sales, so two buyers beyond Harlan are needed. Net 30 on delivery with 32 days to cash means each extra pack must be delivered by about day 13 to settle by day 45. Harlan alone settles $3,200 by day 32, leaving $5,800 unsupported. $30 cost and $0 exposure are within limits; the only gap is who else buys. decisiveLinks = [MARKET_VOLUME] is the decisive gap the evidence decides (a sourced count of AS9100 shops with a current audit need and a channel) — it is missing evidence, not a constraint, and the resolution names it and keeps Harlan's PO delivered regardless.
findings: The revision lists cop_dd6828fceb864333a73c as a member with 3 deals while the stance is NO_PLAN; members should hold only what an adopted plan sells (Harlan's 1 deal at most).

The timeline is tight: research, outreach and two more deliveries must all complete by about day 13, so the resolution should set a research deadline (e.g. day 3) after which the target is out of reach in this window.
